scenes.text: This tutorial covers Map Barcodes. Connect sequencing barcodes and guide identities to the phenotypes measured in microscopy images.
Open Map Barcodes from the Core section. Provide FASTQ files, barcode definitions, plate metadata, and the matching microscopy project.
In the main configuration area, define row, column, and guide barcode layouts together with quality thresholds and mismatch rules.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect sequencing quality and mapping rates before accepting the merged assignments.
When the workflow finishes, guide identities are linked to wells and single-object phenotypes in traceable tables.
